s: When you register with the HomeAdvantage program, you can take advantage of many home buying benefits. You’ll work with knowledgeable real estate agents and have access to their same database of property listings. Plus, you can earn HomeAdvantage Cash Rewards* equal to 20% of your real estate agent’s commission by using a HomeAdvantage agent to buy or sell your home.

Make informed decisions based on in-depth data including recent sales, demographics, schools, crime statistics, and more. Qualify to earn an average of $1,600 in rewards when you use a HomeAdvantage agent for your property transactions.
